text.description_html:
Acorn Bean Tip Rim Latch

Acorn Bean Tip Privacy Rim Latchset has an authentic looking colonial style that makes it perfect for historic home restoration projects. Good for 7/8" to 1-3/4" door thicknesses. Comes with a bean tip handle that is good for both the exterior and the interior use and an easy flip down locking device for privacy. Reversible for right or left handing and comes with reverse bevel so it will work on doors that open in or out. It made out of iron and comes with a smooth black iron finish.

Smooth Black Iron: With a flat black appearance, smooth iron exemplifies the hardware as it was originally forged.

Also available Rough Black Iron Bean Rim Latch Set

Specifications: of the Bean Tip Privacy Rim Latchset:

  • Passage door handle for hall side of door
  • Reverse bevel / closet door handle for room side or exterior of storm door
  • Includes all necessary hardware.
  • Field reservable.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Features of the Rim Latch Set:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Handle Height: 6-3/4"
  • Handle Width: 2-1/2"
  • Projection: 1-5/8"
  • Door Thickness: 7/8" to 1 3/4"

Sold as a set.
